> **Community policy:** Amethys Launcher accepts community participation through GitHub Issues only. Do not submit code changes or patches through Pull Requests.
>
> Please close this PR and open an Issue instead:
> - For a bug, use the Bug report template.
> - For a feature or technical suggestion, use the Feature or technical proposal template.
> - Describe the problem, desired result and (if possible) suggested means of resolution.
>
> The maintainer is responsible for implementing accepted Issues. Pull Requests are reserved for work explicitly authorised by the maintainer under a separate arrangement.
